description: A run waiting in a state with no work is saved and restored as a new top-level run, which starts with `restored` and no other record, and goes on from the saved variables while the original goes on separately. The restored run is suspended once idle (`suspended`, status still running) and that snapshot restored in turn and finished. Suspending a run that has ended gives its final snapshot and writes nothing, and restoring that snapshot is refused (`ended`).
